ai_summary: Bhartiya International Limited announced the resignation of Mr. N Balasubramanian, a highly experienced Business Head - Outerwear with over 30 years in the apparel industry, effective October 9, 2026. This departure of a senior leader with extensive experience and client ties could materially impact the outerwear division and require a robust succession plan. The exceptionally long lead time until his resignation (over two years from the current date) is a red flag that raises questions about potential strategic shifts or underlying reasons for such a pre-announced long-term leadership change.
